visual_review.Q2: No-context and S remain close on both ROIs. Shadow texture is soft in both; no clear new winner.
visual_review.Sony: Both learned methods remain close. Fuselage/window edges are already soft in the noisy capture and remain softened after restoration.
visual_review.GFX50R: Both learned methods retain sharper concrete seams and more surface variation than RawNIND; not all variation can be identified as true detail without a clean reference. No clear new S advantage.
visual_review.decision: No broad qualitative DINO improvement established; retain V43 pending B/full numerical/native/analytic/full-frame review.
